Config.MineRefresh.Name: Mine Refresh
Config.MineRefresh.Tooltip: When on, mine floors with no players in them are refreshed.
Config.MineRefreshInterval.Name: Mine Refresh Interval
Config.MineRefreshInterval.Tooltip: In game minutes (10 game minutes ≈ 7 seconds). 0 = immediately, checked every second.
